description: This Swift source file defines a singleton class `LiveActivityManager` which manages Live Activities within an iOS application using ActivityKit. It handles starting, updating, and ending live activities, with focus on connection states and cleanup of stale activities.

classes.name: LiveActivityManager
classes.description: A singleton responsible for managing the lifecycle of live activities, including starting, updating connection states, and pruning duplicates.

methods.name: startActivity
methods.description: Initiates a new live activity with given agent name and session key, if activities are enabled and no current activity is active.

methods.name: handleConnecting
methods.description: Updates the current activity state to 'Connecting...'.

methods.name: handleReconnect
methods.description: Updates the current activity state to 'Idle'.

methods.name: handleDisconnect
methods.description: Updates the current activity state to 'Disconnected'.

methods.name: hydrateCurrentAndPruneDuplicates
methods.description: Synchronizes the current activity with existing activities, keeping the most recent one and ending stale activities.

methods.name: updateCurrent
methods.description: Updates the current activity's state with provided connection state.

methods.name: connectingState
methods.description: Generates the activity content state indicating connecting status.

methods.name: idleState
methods.description: Generates the activity content state indicating idle status.

methods.name: disconnectedState
methods.description: Generates the activity content state indicating disconnected status.
